entities.name: PMID:10755734
observations: Stewart and Reid compared 15-day repeated ECS with daily fluoxetine in rats; dentate fEPSPs and perforant-path LTP were measured after treatment.

entities.name: ECS-fluoxetine dentate plasticity
observations: In rats treated for 15 days, repeated ECS and chronic fluoxetine each increased dentate fEPSPs versus respective controls and attenuated LTP induction; the abstract calls these effects equivalent but reports no formal equivalence margin or numeric effect estimates.
In a separate Morris watermaze experiment, ECS impaired spatial learning whereas fluoxetine did not, so treatment effects were not globally equivalent.
